packages.title: Boolean Function Complexity Foundation
packages.summary: A complete exact atlas of every labeled Boolean function on one through four variables, with logical, algebraic, Fourier, query-complexity, symmetry, and relation-closure structure.
packages.license: CC0-1.0 data and metadata; Apache-2.0 software

packages.title: Chemical Reaction Network Foundation
packages.summary: An exact canonical atlas of small chemical reaction networks with complete stoichiometric, deficiency, linkage, reversibility, conservation, and catalytic structure.
packages.license: CC0-1.0 data and metadata; Apache-2.0 software

packages.title: Classical Ising Energy Landscape Foundation
packages.summary: An exact finite atlas of classical Ising microstates on open and periodic rectangular lattices, with Hamiltonian statistics, degeneracy, metastability, domains, symmetries, and flip geometry.
packages.license: CC0-1.0 data and metadata; Apache-2.0 software

packages.title: Gene Regulatory Network Foundation
packages.summary: A complete canonical atlas of two- and three-gene signed-threshold regulatory networks with exact synchronous dynamics, attractors, basins, perturbation response, and feedback structure.
packages.license: CC0-1.0 data and metadata; Apache-2.0 software

packages.title: Graph Theory Foundation
packages.summary: A complete-case finite graph Study with 12,359 reconstructible objects, 183 populated descriptors, and attached Python computation and Lean source.

packages.title: Integer Arithmetic Foundation
packages.summary: A research-neutral exact arithmetic Study with 100,000 reconstructible integers, 55 complete scientific fields, and attached Python, C++, and Lean source.

packages.title: Quantum Measurement Compatibility Foundation
packages.summary: An exact finite qubit-measurement compatibility substrate with reconstructible rational Bloch vectors, analytic labels, and inspectable computation software.
packages.license: CC0-1.0 data and metadata; Apache-2.0 software

packages.title: Quantum State Geometry Foundation
packages.summary: A complete finite geometry of reconstructible pure two-qubit state rays with broad Pauli, correlation, entanglement, stabilizer, and computational-basis structure.
